* Excellent communication and escalation management skills.

title: Senior Manager, IT Service Operations
description:

-------------------

* Coach distributed IT staff on service practices, escalation discipline, documentation, and employee communication.
* Use service metrics, trends, and employee feedback to focus improvements on the issues creating the most disruption.

* 8+ years in IT operations or service management, including 4+ years leading technical service operations or ITSM functions.
* Hands-on command of incident, major incident, change, and problem practices, preferably in a global support environment.
* Experience with an ITSM platform, service reporting, operational controls, knowledge management, and service-level management.
* Practical experience improving CMDB accuracy and working with monitoring, event management or observability teams.
* Experience leading teams or cross-functional operational groups across regions, including high-severity incident bridges.

* ITIL certification or equivalent practical experience; exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence requirements.
* Experience operating across India, EMEA, and APAC time zones and working with dotted-line stakeholders.
* Knowledge of automated incident routing, service mapping, and employee lifecycle workflow improvement.
